## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2021-07-16: S-1/A files form-of TRA as exhibit 10.1
- 2021-08-03: Up-C IPO closes; TRA executed between Rani Therapeutics Holdings, Inc. and the Continuing LLC Owners of Rani Therapeutics, LLC, paying 85% of cash tax savings on Section 754 basis step-ups and imputed interest
- 2022-03-31: First 10-K files the executed TRA as exhibit 10.1

#### Termination and release

- 2025-12-31: Tax Receivable Agreement Termination and Release Agreement signed between Rani Holdings and InCube Labs (acting on behalf of all TRA Parties); mutual release of all obligations with no payment owed
- 2026-01-02: 8-K discloses the termination under Item 1.02; signed agreement is not attached as an EDGAR exhibit
- 2026-03-26: 10-K confirms the termination in narrative disclosure

## Explanation

Rani Therapeutics' Up-C IPO on August 3, 2021 created a TRA paying 85% of cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups (and imputed interest) to the Continuing LLC Owners on future Redemptions or Direct Exchanges of Class A Common Units. No amendments followed and no Paired Interest exchanges occurred during the contract's life, so no liability was ever recorded under a full valuation allowance. The TRA was terminated December 31, 2025 via a standalone Termination and Release Agreement with InCube Labs (acting for all TRA Parties), executed concurrent with a private placement and governance restructuring; the agreement was a zero-dollar mutual release rather than a substituted termination payment. The signed termination instrument was not filed as a separate EDGAR exhibit; its terms are established by the January 2, 2026 8-K narrative and the March 26, 2026 10-K disclosure. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record and the manual-verification flag on the missing termination exhibit.
